definition.target_cycle: let p_0,...,p_(T_r-1) be the AL canonical Enterprise endpoint cycle relative to O, in positive turn order, and e_k=(p_k,p_(k+1 mod T_r))
definition.source_embedding: use only the accepted source compatibility embedding iota into the orthogonal plane
definition.fiber_relation: (x,e_k) belongs to R_BRC,r iff the source ray d=x-O lies in the closed positively oriented angular cone from iota(p_k) to iota(p_(k+1))
definition.equivalent_incidence: for interior directions the ray from O through x meets the embedded canonical polygon on the relative interior of e_k
definition.tie_rule: a source ray through a target vertex belongs to both adjacent closed edge fibers; no artificial single-valued tie choice is required

derivation: AD freezes the source orthogonal compatibility circle/chart and triangular incidence carrier; AL independently freezes the unique target frontier. The bridge uses only center-ray incidence between those two frozen objects and therefore compares them without reselecting the target.

strict_angular_progress_certificate.symbol_1: p=(a,b)->(a,b+1): det(p,p')=a>0 on a legal sector interior
strict_angular_progress_certificate.symbol_3: p=(a,b)->(a-1,b): det(p,p')=b>0 on a legal sector interior
strict_angular_progress_certificate.consequence: each canonical turn subtends a nonzero source angular interval; one sector advances strictly from one axis ray to the next and D6 transport covers all six sectors

semantic_boundary: R_BRC,r is a comparison/collapse relation from continuous source states to already-canonical target turns. It is not the target resolver and it does not define target membership.
